name: Guardian of Faith
desc: A spectral guardian deals 20 Radiant damage to nearby enemies (Dexterity saving throw for half).

token.name: Guardian of Faith
token.note: An enemy that moves within 10 feet of it for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Dexterity save (Radiant damage, half on a success). It vanishes after dealing 60 damage.
